title: Image Watermarking With Memory Across Reissuance
abstract: arXiv:2611.23363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Publishers often revise and reissue images, yet valid watermarks may persist on superseded releases or unapproved edits. Even a current release can contain regions last authorized at different revisions. We introduce and formalize reissuable provenance: determining an image's current, superseded, or unissued status and recovering each region's last authorized revision (its generation), with abstention when evidence is insufficient. Generational Stratigraphy Fields (GSF) combine watermark evidence with an authenticated live reference to the current release, enabling replacement or retirement without rewriting circulated copies. Each reissue freshly embeds new generation labels in approved regions and inherited labels elsewhere, preserving history without requiring old watermarks to survive successive edits. Our complete-output reissuance evaluation follows 480 histories through four releases, retaining each AI editor's entire output. GS

translated_title: 具有跨重发行记忆的图像水印
translated_abstract: 出版商经常修改并重新发行图像，然而有效的水印可能会残留在已被取代的版本或未经批准的编辑版本上。即使是当前发行版本，其中不同区域也可能分别在各自不同的修订版本中获得最后授权。我们提出并形式化了“可重发行溯源”这一概念：判定图像处于当前、已被取代或未发行状态，并恢复每个区域最后一次被授权的修订版本（即其“世代”），在证据不足时选择弃权。世代地层场将水印证据与指向当前发行版本的经认证的实时引用相结合，无需重写已流通的副本即可实现版本替换或退役。每次重发行都会在已批准区域中新鲜嵌入新的世代标签，并在其余区域继承原有标签，从而保留历史记录，而无需旧水印在 successive 编辑中持续存留。我们的完整输出重发行评估跟踪了480条图像历史记录跨越四次发行，并保留每个AI编辑器的全部输出。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出可重发行溯源问题与世代地层场（GSF）水印框架，通过在重发行时嵌入新世代标签并继承旧标签、结合指向当前版本的认证实时引用，实现判定图像版本状态并恢复各区域最后授权的修订版本，且无需重写已流通副本。
en_tdlr: Introduces reissuable provenance and Generational Stratigraphy Fields (GSF), a watermarking framework that retains memory across image reissues, enabling determination of an image's current/superseded status and recovery of each region's last authorized revision without rewriting circulated copies.
